headline: EQUINOX GOLD + ORLA MINING FORM $18.5B PRODUCER — 1.1M oz/yr North American gold giant born
snippet: Vancouver-based Equinox Gold is acquiring Orla Mining in a cash-and-stock deal creating an $18.5 billion North American gold producer targeting 1.1 million ounces of annual output, with Equinox shareholders retaining 67% and Orla shareholders receiving 33%. The deal, expected to close Q3 2026, hands Equinox Orla's flagship Camino Rojo mine in Mexico plus assets across the Americas.

headline: COPPER SMASHES ALL-TIME HIGH at $6.60/lb — China demand surge meets US-Iran supply crunch
snippet: LME copper touched $14,000 per tonne ($6.60/lb on COMEX) at fresh all-time highs as resilient Chinese industrial demand across power grids, renewables, and AI infrastructure collides with supply disruptions tied to US-Iran tensions cutting sulphuric acid availability for concentrates. Analysts forecast a 450,000-tonne refined copper supply shortfall in 2026 with limited new mine supply in the pipeline.

headline: BUNKER HILL CONFIRMS new silver-lead vein: 3.02 oz/t Ag, 7.44% Pb over 28.6 feet in Idaho mine
snippet: A second drill hole into the Cate-Eight Vein at the historic Bunker Hill Mine in Idaho confirmed the new zone, returning 28.6 feet at 3.02 oz/ton silver, 7.44% lead, and 0.85% zinc starting at 453 feet — matching and reinforcing the first intercept. The company is on track to restart full mine operations in June 2026 with a 25,000-foot exploration campaign still running.

headline: BRUNSWICK drills 17.7m at 1.10% Li2O — plus 1.84% cesium bonus in Quebec James Bay pegmatite
snippet: Brunswick Exploration's Anatacau Main project in James Bay, Quebec returned 17.7 metres at 1.10% Li2O within a broader 123-metre envelope at 0.72% Li2O, plus an unexpected cesium intercept of 1.84% Cs2O over 11.8 metres — a critical mineral for aerospace and defence. The mineralised pegmatite corridor is now drill-traced over 500 metres and remains open along strike.

headline: FOREMOST CLEAN ENERGY expands Hatchet Lake uranium zone 100m north with high-grade Athabasca hit
snippet: Foremost Clean Energy (NASDAQ: FMST) completed a 19-hole, 3,848-metre drill program at Hatchet Lake South in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin, expanding the Tuning Fork Uranium Zone 100 metres northward with a best intercept of 1.0% eU₃O₈ over 1.4 metres within a 4.6-metre interval. Approximately 600 metres of untested conductive strike remain to the south, pointing to further expansion potential.

headline: SILVER RINGS THE BELL — China buying at record pace as sixth straight annual deficit deepens
snippet: Money Metals argues silver's separation from gold is structurally driven: China has imported over 790 tonnes in early 2026 despite historically being a net exporter, while mine production continues to lag demand from solar panels, EVs, and electronics manufacturing. The sixth consecutive annual silver supply deficit is on track to widen, adding structural support beneath the metal's sharp price rally.

headline: Gold off 16% from $5,589 January ATH — J.P. Morgan, Deutsche Bank hold $5,000+ price targets
snippet: With gold trading near $4,686 after retreating from its January record of $5,589, major institutions remain constructive: J.P. Morgan targets $5,055 by Q4 2026, Deutsche Bank models $6,000, and Goldman Sachs pegs a $4,900 base with upside above $5,000. Analysts cite projected central bank purchases of 755 tonnes in 2026 and US CPI at 3.8% — the highest since May 2023 — as the floor under prices.

headline: Goliath Resources preps FULLY FUNDED 50,000m drill push to expand 46 veins at Surebet gold discovery
snippet: Goliath Resources added a veteran mining executive and is finalising mobilisation for a fully funded 50,000-metre drill program targeting expansion of 46 mineralised veins at the Surebet Discovery in British Columbia. The program is designed to materially grow the resource footprint and position Surebet for a formal resource estimate.

headline: The best RARE EARTH stock to hold for the next decade — Motley Fool's May 2026 long-term pick
snippet: As rare earth and critical mineral equities surge in 2026 on U.S. government funding and China's continued dominance of processing capacity, Motley Fool names its top Western rare earth pick for long-term investors looking beyond the prominent funded names. Published May 12, 2026.

headline: First Mining Q1 2026: $44.8M cash, Duparquet gold drills 7.18 g/t Au over 8m at Miroir target
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX: FF) reported Q1 2026 results with $44.8 million in cash and securities, reinforcing its balance sheet ahead of advancing the flagship Duparquet gold project in Quebec; drill highlights from the Miroir target include 7.18 g/t Au over 8.0 metres and 3.74 g/t Au over 15.5 metres. Management noted no debt and a fully funded exploration path.
